build_mslr_web_dataset: build a tensorflow dataset builder for MSLR-WEB learning-to-rank dataset with configurable size and fold
create_mslr_web_config: create a builder config for mslr_web dataset specifying size (10k or 30k) and fold number
test_mslr_web_info: test the mslr_web dataset info including features, metadata, and feature names mapping
run_mslr_web_splits: run mslr_web split generation to produce train, validation, and test splits from libsvm files
generate_mslr_web_examples: generate examples from libsvm ranking parser with combined float features and relevance labels
